content: Pakistan credential verification: PNMC (formerly PNC) online portal lets public verify a nurse/lHV/midwife by CNIC against the official register; PMDC lets you search doctors by registration number and see license validity. SHCC licensing requires valid registration with PMDC/PNC. Section 23 PNMC Act 2023 prohibits employing unregistered nurses. Manual credential review is standard for marketplaces (Qare verifies against PNC register + CNIC; Nannzy verifies CNIC + credentials; E-Tib admin reviews CNIC + professional document).
